# Miux Studio — Studio Overview

## About
Miux Studio is a design and engineering studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We work with startups and established teams across APAC and the UAE on brand identity, websites, and digital products. Our practice pairs visual craft with production engineering: the same team designs, builds, and ships.

Founded: 2016
Website: https://www.miux.studio

## Services
1. **Brand Design & Identity** — positioning, visual identity, design systems, brand guidelines.
2. **Web Design & UI/UX** — information architecture, interface design, prototyping, usability testing.
3. **Web Development** — Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, headless CMS integration.
4. **AI Automation & Systems** — internal tooling, API integration, workflow automation.
5. **Ads & Campaign Strategy** — creative direction, ad production, media planning.

## Process
1. Discovery call (45 minutes) to understand goals, audience, and constraints.
2. Written scope and fixed proposal with milestones.
3. Weekly sprints across strategy, design, and build.
4. Launch, handover, and an optional support retainer.

Typical timeline: brand identity 4–6 weeks; website design and build 8–10 weeks; combined engagements 4–10 weeks depending on scope.

## Engagement & Pricing
- Starter: USD 2,400 per month
- Growth: USD 4,800 per month
- Enterprise: USD 8,900 per month
- Annual partnership: 20% off the monthly rate, billed annually
- Custom scoping available for multi-surface programs

Prices are in USD, excluding applicable taxes.

## Selected Work
- Verdant Skincare — brand identity and packaging system
- Nimbus Financial — website redesign for institutional and retail audiences
- Atlas Logistics — freight operations web application with real-time tracking
- Medica Health — telemedicine UX overhaul for patients and clinicians in the UAE
- Ember Coffee Co. — multi-channel campaign and media buying
- Horizon Education — brand identity and digital presence for an ed-tech startup
- Solstice AI Engine — AI research platform with real-time telemetry
- Aura Spatial Living — immersive e-commerce and 3D interior showcase
- Krypton Liquidity Protocol — institutional trading interface
- Vanguard Electric Hypercar — global launch campaign and reservation funnel

## Technology
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI, headless CMS platforms, and standard cloud deployment.
